title: Reflective Growth Across a Psychology Career - Trainee Clinical Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱以外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”课程现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了该课程，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的职业旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。

sentences.en: Coming up today, get ready to dive into the rollercoaster ride of a third-year trainee clinical psychologist's journey.
sentences.zh: 今天，准备好深入了解一位三年级临床心理学实习生的过山车之旅吧。

sentences.en: We're about to spill the beans on personal and professional growth.
sentences.zh: 我们将揭示个人和职业成长背后的点点滴滴。

sentences.en: And trust me, it's anything but boring.
sentences.zh: 相信我，这绝对不会枯燥。

sentences.en: Whether you're into self-discovery, figuring out your own career chaos, or just love a good story of transformation, then this episode is for you.
sentences.zh: 无论你是热衷于自我发现、理清自己的职业困境，还是仅仅喜欢听一个精彩的蜕变故事，这一集都非常适合你。

sentences.en: We are peeling back the layers of the ups and downs of a psychology career and exploring how we all go through some pretty significant changes and growth as a result.
sentences.zh: 我们将剥开心理学职业生涯中起起伏伏的层面，探讨我们是如何因此经历重大的变化和成长的。

sentences.en: Hit play, grab a cuppa, and let's get real about the messy, beautiful evolution we call life as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 点击播放，泡上一杯茶，让我们坦诚地聊聊作为一名心理学家，那场混乱而美丽的进化过程。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: So, I am joined today by Phil.
sentences.zh: 今天和我一起的是 Phil。

sentences.en: And yeah, I think you're going to find it a really interesting episode.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你会觉得这一集非常有趣。

sentences.en: I found it such a privilege to speak with him.
sentences.zh: 能与他交谈，我感到非常荣幸。

sentences.en: So, I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们稍后再见。

sentences.en: Just want to welcome Phil Pamperlove to the podcast today.
sentences.zh: 我想欢迎 Phil Pamperlove 来到今天的播客。

sentences.en: Welcome along, Phil.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，Phil。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne, and thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Marianne，谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Oh, thanks for saying yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你答应参加。

sentences.en: I reached out to you via LinkedIn because I saw your research.
sentences.zh: 我在 LinkedIn 上联系你，是因为我看到了你的研究。

sentences.en: So, you are a trainee clinical psychologist, and we will come on to what that's been like for you.
sentences.zh: 你现在是一名临床心理学实习生，我们稍后会谈谈你的这段经历。

sentences.en: But you are currently doing your research kind of recruitment drive, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你目前正在进行研究招募工作，对吧？

sentences.en: Is that fair to say you're still in that cycle currently?
sentences.zh: 可以说你还处在这个周期中吗？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So, could you tell us, before we kind of get into all of that, could you tell us a little bit about yourself and how you got into psychology?
sentences.zh: 那么，在我们深入探讨之前，你能先简单介绍一下你自己以及你是如何进入心理学领域的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, gosh, where do I begin?
sentences.zh: 好的，天哪，我该从哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: So, basically, when I was at school, I didn't really know, you know, like many children, exactly what I wanted to do at the very start.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我在学校的时候，和许多孩子一样，一开始并不知道自己到底想做什么。

sentences.en: I know some people are like, I want to be a nurse when I grow up.
sentences.zh: 我知道有些人会说，我长大后想当护士。

sentences.en: I wasn't quite like that.
sentences.zh: 我不太一样。

sentences.en: And also, bearing in mind that I grew up in Bulgaria, that's where I went to school.
sentences.zh: 而且要考虑到我是在保加利亚长大的，我在那里上的学。

sentences.en: So, I think that's kind of, that cultural difference is important as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这种文化差异也很重要。

sentences.en: So, I remember going through a period in secondary school where I was thinking,
sentences.zh: 我记得在中学时期，我曾有一段时间在想：

sentences.en: I want to be a film director.
sentences.zh: 我想当电影导演。

sentences.en: I want to be the teacher.
sentences.zh: 我想当老师。

sentences.en: I want to be this and that.
sentences.zh: 我想做这个做那个。

sentences.en: And I didn't fully kind of know really what I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 我并没有完全清楚自己到底想做什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was definitely my teenage years where I kind of started thinking about it a bit more fully and thinking, who, you know, who am I?
sentences.zh: 是的，确实是在青少年时期，我开始更全面地思考这个问题，思考我是谁？

sentences.en: What's important to me?
sentences.zh: 什么对我来说很重要？

sentences.en: Where do I see myself?
sentences.zh: 我对自己有什么期望？

sentences.en: I knew that I wanted to work with people and also knew I wanted to help people to kind of help understand themselves.
sentences.zh: 我知道我想与人打交道，也知道我想帮助人们去理解他们自己。

sentences.en: And obviously, again, that's not, you know, that's still such a broad thing to think about.
sentences.zh: 当然，这仍然是一个非常宽泛的想法。

sentences.en: But I remember saying to myself, you know, psychology is such a big field, you know, this is where you do work a lot with people, not in like a very kind of corporate, but
sentences.zh: 但我记得我对自己说，心理学是一个很大的领域，在这里你确实与人有很多接触，不是那种非常企业化的方式，而是

sentences.en: in the more sorts of, you know, empathetic way.
sentences.zh: 以一种更具同理心的方式。

sentences.en: So, I thought to myself, you know, let me do a psychology degree and see what, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我对自己说，让我读个心理学学位，看看它到底会把我带向何方，因为心理学本身作为一门学科是非常非常广阔的。

sentences.en: where exactly that's going to take me because psychology in itself is so, so vast as a discipline.
sentences.zh: 所以我于 2011 年到 2014 年在英国完成了我的本科学位。

sentences.en: So, I did my undergraduate degree between 2011 and 2014 in the UK.
sentences.zh: 在第一年，我又陷入了那种状态，不知道自己想做什么。

sentences.en: During the first year, again, I kind of found myself in that place where I was like, I don't know what I want to do.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我知道我想与人打交道，但不知道在心理学领域内具体往哪个方向走。

sentences.en: Like, again, I knew I wanted to work with people, but didn't know exactly where within psychology to sort of go.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是在第二年，我开始考虑临床心理学这条路。

sentences.en: And I think it was during the second year, maybe, where I was sort of thinking around the clinical psychology route in particular.
sentences.zh: 我记得读到临床心理学家的工作描述时，

sentences.en: And thinking to myself, you know, I remember reading the description of what a clinical psychologist does.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这简直就是我的写照。

sentences.en: And I was like, this is literally me in a nutshell.
sentences.zh: 这本质上就是我，因为这里面包含了所有我真正热爱的东西。

sentences.en: This is quintessentially me because you've got everything in there that I really, you know, love.
sentences.zh: 我是一个喜欢做不同事情的人。

sentences.en: I'm someone who enjoys kind of doing different things.
sentences.zh: 如果我每天都在重复做同样的事情，我知道我不会适应。

sentences.en: If I do the exact same thing every day in, day out, I know that that's not going to sit well with me.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢心理学的这些不同方面，比如与客户合作，

sentences.en: And I really loved all these different facets of psychology in terms of working with clients,
sentences.zh: 同时也与团队合作，在更广泛的层面上工作，比如服务开发、协作、做研究，还有领导力方面。

sentences.en: but also with teams, you know, working kind of on a broader level in terms of, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，使用不同的模型并学习所有这些模型，

sentences.en: service development, working collaboratively, doing research, the leadership things as well.
sentences.zh: 这一切对我来说就是：太棒了，太棒了，太棒了。

sentences.en: So it was working with different models and learning about all of these models.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All of that was just like, yes, yes, and yes.
sentences.zh: 然后在第三年结束时，我心想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我知道本科毕业后直接申请是进不去的，但我想看看那是什么样的。

sentences.en: And then at the end of the third year, I was thinking to myself, do you know what?
sentences.zh: 所以我记得我经历了申请过程，想看看会是什么样。

sentences.en: I know I'm not going to get on as soon as I apply after an undergraduate degree, but let me see what that's like.
sentences.zh: 我甚至没有提交申请。

sentences.en: So I remember like going through the application process to sort of see what that's like.
sentences.zh: 我只是想看看会出现什么样的问题。

sentences.en: I didn't even submit it.
sentences.zh: 第二年，我读了一个临床心理学基础的硕士学位，那是一年的课程。

sentences.en: I just sort of want to see what kind of questions might come up.
sentences.zh: 但在那一年里，我觉得在很短的时间内发生了很多事情，因为我找到了一份实习工作，每周有一天我作为一名志愿者和荣誉助理心理学家在当地服务机构工作。

sentences.en: And the year after that, I did a master's in foundations of clinical psychology, which was, yeah, it was one year.
sentences.zh: 剩下的时间就是听课和学习。

sentences.en: But within that one year, I feel like a lot of things happened very quickly in a short span of time because I managed to find a bit like a placement where one day a week I was
sentences.zh: 在那期间，我还是一名志愿研究助理。

sentences.en: a voluntary and honorary assistant psychologist in a local service.
sentences.zh: 所以我参与了临床工作和研究工作，同时还在学习。

sentences.en: And then the rest of the week was sort of lectures and study time.
sentences.zh: 我再次对自己说，是的，这就是我想要前进的方向。

sentences.en: And during that time, I was also a voluntary research assistant.
sentences.zh: 硕士毕业后，我很幸运地在那个服务机构获得了一个带薪职位，

sentences.en: So I was kind of involved in clinical stuff and research stuff and then doing my studies alongside.
sentences.zh: 当时我还在做实习，同时还兼职做自闭症和/或智力障碍服务机构的支持工作者。

sentences.en: And again, I thought to myself, yes, this is exactly where I want to be heading.
sentences.zh: 我当时在两份工作之间奔波。

sentences.en: And yeah, after I did my master's, I was really lucky to kind of get a paid position within
sentences.zh: 后来，我又得到了一份兼职助理心理学家的工作，它们相辅相成，我把时间分成了两个两点五天。

sentences.en: that service where I was on placements and I was also working part-time as a support worker with services with autism and or intellectual disabilities.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，我真的很幸运能得到这两份工作，因为我知道它们现在有多么难得。

sentences.en: And I was kind of juggling the two.
sentences.zh: 但那是两个非常不同的服务机构，两个非常不同的团队，我从中学到了很多。

sentences.en: And then later on, I got another part-time assistant psychologist post and then they kind of complemented each other and I was split to two and a half and two and a half days.
sentences.zh: 我确实怀念我一起工作过的人。

sentences.en: And again, I was really looking back.
sentences.zh: 我记得我共事过的每一位同事和每一位患者，记得非常清楚。

sentences.en: I think I was really lucky to kind of land both of these, knowing how much of a gold dust sort of thing they are now.
sentences.zh: 然后我记得申请博士学位大概有四年了。

sentences.en: But they were two very different services, two very different teams, and I really learned a lot from them.
sentences.zh: 我在努力回忆已经过去多少年了。

sentences.en: And I do miss, you know, the people I work with.
sentences.zh: 我确实有过怀疑自己的时刻，心想，天哪，这值得吗？

sentences.en: I remember, you know, every colleague and every patient I've worked with very, very well.
sentences.zh: 这真的很耗人。

sentences.en: And then I remember applying for the doctorates probably four years.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常艰难的过程。

sentences.en: I'm trying to remember how many years it's been.
sentences.zh: 当我连续一两年或三年被拒绝时，我会想，嗯，让我重新评估一下我想去的地方。

sentences.en: And, you know, I definitely had moments when I was thinking to myself, gosh, is it worth it?
sentences.zh: 我知道这就是我想要前进的方向。

sentences.en: You know, this is really draining.
sentences.zh: 所以我重新审视了我的整个申请。

sentences.en: This is a really hard process.
sentences.zh: 我彻底改变了我的个人陈述。

sentences.en: And then I would go, you know, when I was sort of, when I had no's basically for one or two or three years or whatever.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I was like, hmm, you know, let me reevaluate, you know, where I wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 然后我成功获得了几次面试机会。

sentences.en: I knew this is where I wanted to be heading.
sentences.zh: 即使在那些面试之后我没有成功，我也觉得，是的，我走在正确的轨道上。

sentences.en: So I reviewed my whole application.
sentences.zh: 有些事情不一样了。

sentences.en: I completely changed my sort of personal statements in there.
sentences.zh: 它们本身就是非常好的学习经历。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 然后，奇迹发生了，2021 年，我成功获得了我梦寐以求的大学的面试机会。

sentences.en: And then I managed to get a couple of interviews.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的为自己感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: And even though I wasn't successful after those interviews that I was like, yes, I'm on the right track with this.
sentences.zh: 我的家人和朋友也说，你真的应得的。

sentences.en: You know, something's different.
sentences.zh: 那通电话对我来说绝对是一个非常难忘的时刻。

sentences.en: And they were really good learning experience in themselves.
sentences.zh: Marianne，我刚才说得太多了。

sentences.en: And then, lo and behold, in 2021, I managed to get an interview at the university I really, really wanted.
sentences.zh: 那不是废话。

sentences.en: And I was, yeah, I was so, so chuffed with myself.
sentences.zh: 那很精彩。

sentences.en: And my family and friends, again, they were like, you really, really deserve this.
sentences.zh: 我想我可以听你讲几个小时，Phil。

sentences.en: And it was definitely a very memorable moment for me, that phone call that I got.
sentences.zh: 我会闭嘴的。

sentences.en: So that was a big waffle there, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 听你说话真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: It wasn't a waffle.
sentences.zh: 而且，我总是被这种毅力和决心所打动，就像我被我自己的故事所打动一样。

sentences.en: It was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 听你说话时，我在想，天哪，搬到一个全新的国家，一个你不认识任何人的地方，这真是一件大事。

sentences.en: I could listen to you speak for hours, I think, Phil.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，哦，是的，你也做到了。

sentences.en: I'll just zip my mouth.
sentences.zh: 我当时是去了威尔士，但离家也有三个半小时的路程。

sentences.en: You're really, really interesting to listen to.
sentences.zh: 我们做的事情确实很大。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm always struck, as I'm also struck by my own story as well, of just this perseverance and this determination.
sentences.zh: 你的情况显然是完全不同的文化。

sentences.en: And I was listening to you speak, and I was thinking, gosh, moving off to a whole new country, like where you don't know anyone, that's such a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是从英格兰到威尔士，但我们确实为了自己的热情搬来搬去，不是吗？

sentences.en: And then I thought, oh, yeah, you did do that too.
sentences.zh: 你一直都知道你想来英国并在英国获得专业资格吗？

sentences.en: Mine was Wales, but it was still three and a half hours away.
sentences.zh: 留在保加利亚是一个选择吗？

sentences.en: You know, it's a big thing we do.
sentences.zh: 还是说那根本不是你想要的？

sentences.en: You know, yours was obviously a whole different culture.
sentences.zh: 是的，好问题。

sentences.en: It's not just England to Wales, but we do move around a lot for our passions, don't we?
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常复杂且微妙的问题。

sentences.en: Did you always know that you would want to come to UK and do your professional qualification in the UK?
sentences.zh: 因为，是的，我确实可以选择去保加利亚并留在那里。

sentences.en: Would that have been an option to stay in Bulgaria?
sentences.zh: 我在那里完成了学业，但我只是觉得那不是我真正想要大展拳脚的地方。

sentences.en: Or was that just not what you wanted?
sentences.zh: 即使是现在，在我完成学业后，也没有什么能阻止我去保加利亚执业，如果我想的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, good question.
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得，文化心态也有一些因素，

sentences.en: And I think it's a very complex and nuanced question.
sentences.zh: 当时我申请大学时，我有朋友已经在英国了，他们说了很多积极的事情。

sentences.en: Because, yes, I did have the option to, you know, to go to Bulgaria and stay there.
sentences.zh: 我记得我在中学时期曾有一段时间对英国和英国人的心态非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: I complete my studies there, but I just didn't really feel that that was where I really wanted to sort of thrive.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，是的，我能看到自己在这里。

sentences.en: And even now, like nothing's stopping me, you know, after I finished my studies to go to Bulgaria and practice there if I wanted to.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在保加利亚，某些事情的发展比西方慢一点。

sentences.en: But I just, I feel like, yeah, there's something about the cultural mentality as well, where,
sentences.zh: 考虑到那里的一些价值观和信仰，我认为这是可以理解的。

sentences.en: you know, at that time when I was applying for university, I had friends who were already in the UK and saying really positive things about it.
sentences.zh: 例如，我是兄弟姐妹中的老大，作为唯一的男性，我也反思过这一点，这意味着我有责任表现出色，了解很多事情，引领道路，成为那个开拓者。

sentences.en: And I just, yeah, I remember being, going through a period in secondary school where I was like really interested in the UK and the British mentality.
sentences.zh: 就像在雪地里，雪很厚，你不知道该往哪里走。

sentences.en: And that's what I love about clinical placements as well, is you get the chance to enter someone else's world for six months.
sentences.zh: 你可以尝试一切，你可以思考，我喜欢哪些部分？

sentences.en: You get to try everything on, you know, and you get to think, which bits do I like?
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢哪些部分？

sentences.en: Which bits don't I like?
sentences.zh: 我会保留哪些？

sentences.en: Which will I keep?
sentences.zh: 你会把哪些留在这里，然后永远不再回头？

sentences.en: You know, and which will I leave here and then never, never, ever return to again?
sentences.zh: 有时，你会得到这样的机会，人们会说，噢，我们有一个合格的七级职位空缺。

sentences.en: And sometimes, you know, you get that opportunity that people are like, oh, well, we've got maybe a qualified band seven job coming up.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意回来，我们会很高兴。

sentences.en: We'd love it if you'd consider coming back.
sentences.zh: 然后你会想，我想要那个吗？

sentences.en: And then you're like, well, do I want that?
sentences.zh: 这真的非常非常好。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's really, really nice.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，这是培训的一部分，让你弄清楚这些事情。

sentences.en: It's part, like you say, it's part of training that you kind of get to figure that stuff out.
sentences.zh: 但我获得资格时，经济环境非常不同，我希望我们不会再次走向那种环境，因为人们越来越重视心理健康的重要性。

sentences.en: But when I qualified, actually, it was in a very different economic climate, which may
sentences.zh: 而在2011年我获得资格时，他们决定通过削减心理健康培训名额来省钱，这可能导致了我们现在看到的一些心理健康危机，

sentences.en: be, I hope we're not heading towards again, because of the increased importance and highlighting about how important mental health is.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是心理学领域，他们在不同学科中也这样做。

sentences.en: Whereas in 2011, when I qualified, they sort of decided to save money by axing places for mental health training, which has probably contributed to some of the mental health crisis
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一些关于心理健康护士资助的变动，不是吗？

sentences.en: we see, not just from psychology, but, you know, they did it across different disciplines as well.
sentences.zh: 他们规定你必须使用你的，那不再是助学金了。

sentences.en: Even there was some dalliances with mental health nurse funding, wasn't there?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们试图在各处省钱。

sentences.en: They made it that you had to use your, it was no longer bursary.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们申请工作时，我们确实有一些会考虑的选项，觉得这适合我。

sentences.en: You know, they were trying to save money everywhere.
sentences.zh: 但我们实际上不得不申请一切。

sentences.en: So when it came to us applying for jobs, we absolutely had the things that we would consider, this is a bit of me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如果我没有经历过那些，我的职业生涯会如何发展，因为实际上我第一份合格的工作是往返27英里的路程，

sentences.en: But we were literally having to apply for everything.
sentences.zh: 沿着M6公路，那不是我的首选。

sentences.en: And I don't know how my career would have unfolded had I not had that, because actually my first qualified job was a 27 mile trip each way, you know, up the M6, like it was
sentences.zh: 而且，我不一定会认为自己是一名CAMHS（儿童及青少年心理健康服务）临床医生，但我发现自己在一个非常优秀的团队中工作。

sentences.en: not my first choice.
sentences.zh: 他们因安全而获奖，这确实帮助我为合格后的工作打下了不可思议的基础。

sentences.en: And, you know, I wouldn't necessarily have considered myself a CAMHS clinician, but found myself working in a team that just was so good.
sentences.zh: 他们富有同情心，善良，可爱。

sentences.en: They won awards for safety, that it really helped me develop incredible foundations for qualified work.
sentences.zh: 我与各种各样的家庭和客户群体进行了大量工作，使用了口译员，这正是我所需要的，但我当时并不知道我需要它。

sentences.en: They were compassionate, they were kind, they were lovely.
sentences.zh: 所以，我最终在那里工作了近四年。

sentences.en: I did so much work with kind of diverse families and client groups and, you know, using interpreters and it was just what I needed, but I didn't know I needed it, you know?
sentences.zh: 如果我当时有选择，我可能不会选择那样的通勤，因为单程可能需要一个半小时。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I ended up working there for almost four years as well.
sentences.zh: 我获得资格后反而更穷了，因为我必须支付市政税，而且显然没有差旅费补贴。

sentences.en: But where I would have done, you know, I would not, probably nobody would necessarily choose to do that commute because it was probably up to an hour and a half each way.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一名合格的医生，我比作为六级实习生时更穷。

sentences.en: I was worse off when I qualified because I then had to pay council tax and I obviously got no travel funding.
sentences.zh: 但我不会交换它，因为它造就了今天的我，我真的很喜欢现在的自己和所做的工作。

sentences.en: So I was worse off as a qualified than I was as a band six trainee.
sentences.zh: 所以这完全是题外话。

sentences.en: But I wouldn't swap it because it made me the clinician I am today and I really like, really like the clinician I am and the stuff I do.
sentences.zh: 但我希望你能有一次让你对第一份合格工作感到满意的经历，

sentences.en: So that is a complete other aside.
sentences.zh: 即使它在纸面上看起来比我的更适合你。

sentences.en: But yeah, like I hope you have an experience where you're delighted with your first qualified
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: role, even though it might be one that on paper looks already a bit more like a bit of you than mine did.
sentences.zh: 噢，谢谢你，Marianne。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 听到关于你第一份工作的故事真的很暖心，因为我觉得这对三年级学生来说会很可怕，尤其是想到，噢天哪，我需要开始申请工作并参加面试了。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so kind of heartwarming to hear about your first job because I think it'd be quite scary for third years, especially thinking, oh gosh, like I need to actually start applying
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: for jobs and go to a job interview.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And you sort of finding that you really loved that job and the people you were with, you learned so much from it.
sentences.zh: 你会发现自己真的很热爱那份工作，也很喜欢共事的人，你从中获益良多。

sentences.en: And I think that's probably where the placements have been really important for me, for me personally on our course.
sentences.zh: 我想，这可能就是实习对我个人而言，在我们的课程中显得如此重要的原因。

sentences.en: I feel like I've learned so much from them.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我从实习中学到了很多。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure how it was on your course, but with us, we sort of do two adult placements
sentences.zh: 我不确定你们的课程是怎么安排的，但我们课程通常会进行两次成人实习，

sentences.en: in the first year, both around five, six months long, and then two five to six months placements
sentences.zh: 都在第一年，每次大约五到六个月，然后在第二年进行两次五到六个月的实习，

sentences.en: in the second year, one with children and young people, the other one with people with intellectual disabilities.
sentences.zh: 一次是针对儿童和青少年，另一次是针对智力障碍人士。

sentences.en: And then the final year, you do one longer placement, around 10 months-ish long, and you can kind of select your top three choices for which way you sort of want to be.
sentences.zh: 最后一年，你需要进行一次较长的实习，大约10个月左右，你可以选择你最想去的三个方向。

sentences.en: So the final decision isn't yours, but you've got a lot more control.
sentences.zh: 所以最终决定权不在你手里，但你拥有了更多的自主权。

sentences.en: And I managed to get my first choice for my third year, and I was so over the moon.
sentences.zh: 我成功争取到了第三年实习的第一志愿，当时我简直欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: And I've said to my partner, like, I didn't for a second, like, regret making that choice because I really feel like I'm learning so much.
sentences.zh: 我跟我的伴侣说过，我从未有一刻后悔过那个选择，因为我真的觉得我学到了很多。

sentences.en: I'm kind of heading in the direction I want to be heading.
sentences.zh: 我正朝着我想要的方向前进。

sentences.en: It's not just trainee Phil, but also future qualified, hopefully Dr. Phil, by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是实习生Phil，也是未来的合格心理学家，希望到年底就是Phil博士了。

sentences.en: So yeah, I think placements are a really big part where you can start learning a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为实习是你可以开始大量学习的一个非常重要的部分。

sentences.en: I've dealt with a lot of things in my placements that I wouldn't have even dreamed of doing when I was an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我在实习中处理过很多事情，这在以前做助理心理学家时是我想都不敢想的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And you do just end up having to walk because you find yourself to be there.
sentences.zh: 你最终不得不去面对，因为你发现自己就在那里。

sentences.en: And, you know, I felt quite emotional as you spoke then.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，刚才听你说话时，我感到很动情。

sentences.en: Like, I felt, I had the feels.
sentences.zh: 就像，我感觉到了，我很有感触。

sentences.en: Like, it made me feel like I might have a little bit of a cry.
sentences.zh: 感觉我快要流泪了。

sentences.en: Like, what a privilege, you know, to be able to have that level of personal and professional growth and get paid for it.
sentences.zh: 能拥有这种个人和职业层面的成长，还能因此获得报酬，这真是太荣幸了。

sentences.en: You know, and I know if you're a counselling trainee, you're listening to this thinking, I don't get paid and I have to pay.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我知道如果现在有咨询专业的实习生在听，他们会想：我不仅没钱拿，还得自己掏钱。

sentences.en: It was such an inequity and I wish that could be changed.
sentences.zh: 这确实很不公平，我真希望这种情况能有所改变。

sentences.en: But, you know, speaking as a qualified clean psych who got paid to train, it, you know, not every day was easy.
sentences.zh: 但是，作为一名拿薪水培训出来的合格临床心理学家，我想说，并非每一天都轻松。

sentences.en: Of course it wasn't, but just incredible.
sentences.zh: 当然不是，但这一切都太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And I still think I've got the best job in the world.
sentences.zh: 我依然认为我拥有世界上最好的工作。

sentences.en: Like, I love it.
sentences.zh: 我热爱它。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很爱它。

sentences.en: Yeah, same.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我也是。

sentences.en: And you just kind of feel when it's right that you sort of like, it's hard to verbalise it, but you definitely, at the end of the day, when you come back and like, yes, it
sentences.zh: 当你觉得一切都对的时候，你会有那种感觉，很难用言语表达，但当你一天结束回来时，你肯定会觉得，是的，它

sentences.en: might have been a tough day, but there's something about this that I really, really love.
sentences.zh: 可能度过了艰难的一天，但这份工作中确实有些东西让我非常非常热爱。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Is there anything else on this topic around kind of what we learn along the journey that that we haven't said or that you think might be useful that comes to you for that kind
sentences.zh: 关于我们在旅途中所学到的东西，还有什么我们没提到，或者你认为可能有用、能作为播客主题的话题吗？

sentences.en: of podcast topic title?
sentences.zh: 播客主题标题？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: And I guess I'm kind of addressing this to anyone who might be watching this, not necessarily trainees qualified to know could be aspiring.
sentences.zh: 我想我是对所有正在观看的人说的，不一定是正在培训的，也可能是未来的准心理学家。

sentences.en: At whatever stage you are, really pause and think about who you are, because I remember one kind of teaching that we had is where the lecturer said to us, you know, imagine
sentences.zh: 无论你处于哪个阶段，真的要停下来思考一下你是谁，因为我记得我们上过一门课，讲师对我们说，想象

sentences.en: an animal, you know, pick an animal that you want to represent you as a, or where you would like to see yourself as a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 一种动物，选一种你想用来代表你自己的动物，或者你想成为什么样的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: It was something along those lines.
sentences.zh: 大概就是类似这样的内容。

sentences.en: And I remember I thought really, really long for that.
sentences.zh: 我记得我为此思考了很久很久。

sentences.en: And in the end, I chose a chameleon.
sentences.zh: 最后，我选择了变色龙。

sentences.en: And so each one of us kind of went, we went around and we sort of, each one of us spoke about why they chose that animal.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都轮流发言，讲述自己为什么选择那种动物。

sentences.en: And I said, well, I chose the chameleon because I feel like, in a sense, I want to be someone
sentences.zh: 我说，我选择变色龙是因为我觉得，在某种意义上，我想成为一个

sentences.en: who is flexible and adapts well to different environments and, you know, different needs.
sentences.zh: 灵活且能很好地适应不同环境和不同需求的人。

sentences.en: But at the same time, at the very core, I'm still the same person.
sentences.zh: 但同时，在内心深处，我依然是同一个人。

sentences.en: And so I might change sort of the colours, but I'm still there.
sentences.zh: 所以我可能会改变颜色，但我还是我。

sentences.en: The fill is still there.
sentences.zh: 那个Phil依然在那里。

sentences.en: So I kind of want to incorporate that malleability and flexibility, but still stay true to what's important to me.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要融合这种适应性和灵活性，但同时保持初心，坚持对我而言重要的事情。

sentences.en: And my partner drew a chameleon and gave it to me as a birthday gift later on.
sentences.zh: 后来我的伴侣画了一只变色龙作为生日礼物送给我。

sentences.en: And I still have that.
sentences.zh: 我至今还留着它。

sentences.en: So every time I kind of see it, it sort of reminds me, yes, this chameleon is me.
sentences.zh: 所以每次看到它，它都会提醒我，是的，这只变色龙就是我。

sentences.en: And I know why.
sentences.zh: 我知道原因。

sentences.en: Like, I understand why.
sentences.zh: 我明白为什么。

sentences.en: So really think about who you are and how other people would see you.
sentences.zh: 所以，真的要好好思考你是谁，以及别人会如何看待你。

sentences.en: I think that's such a nice reframe on a chameleon, because for me, sometimes the term chameleon is almost lobbied about as a bit of an insult.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个对“变色龙”非常好的重新定义，因为对我来说，有时“变色龙”这个词几乎被当作一种侮辱。

sentences.en: Like, but I think you're right.
sentences.zh: 但是，我觉得你是对的。

sentences.en: Like, it's about survival, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这关乎生存，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's about, you know, being a part of something and helping it.
sentences.zh: 这关乎成为整体的一部分并提供帮助。

sentences.en: I don't know, helping what needs to happen, happen, but in a way that isn't putting all your own stuff and your own agenda onto what the process is.
sentences.zh: 我不知道怎么说，就是帮助需要发生的事情顺利进行，但方式不是把自己的东西和议程强加到过程中。

sentences.en: I don't think I'm explaining this very well, but, you know.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我没解释清楚，但你懂的。

sentences.en: I get what you mean.
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's not an insult, is it?
sentences.zh: 是的，这并不是一种侮辱，对吧？

sentences.en: It's a real skill to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 能做到这一点是一种真正的技能。

sentences.en: But of course, to remain, like you said, to still remain the same underneath, but just to be able to, it's an amazing survival strategy, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但当然，正如你所说，在保持内在自我的同时，能够做到这一点，这是一种了不起的生存策略，不是吗？

sentences.en: Like, it's amazing as a, you know, it makes me think about Harry Potter and his invisibility cloak.
sentences.zh: 这让我想到了哈利·波特和他的隐形斗篷。

sentences.en: Like, what would you get up to if you had one of those?
sentences.zh: 如果你有那样一件斗篷，你会做什么？

sentences.en: Like, you know, what can you do if you can just be yourself, but know how to help others around you maximize everything that they're doing, you know?
sentences.zh: 如果你能做你自己，同时又知道如何帮助周围的人最大限度地发挥他们的潜能，你能做些什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, and I totally get what you mean when you first say, yeah, I wouldn't think about that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全明白你刚开始说的那种顾虑。

sentences.en: Because when I first thought about it, I was like, oh, but then people might think I'm
sentences.zh: 因为我第一次想到这个时，我也在想，哦，但别人可能会觉得我

sentences.en: like being a phony or like hypocrite or something and not really, you know, lying just to kind of please them or sort of, but I was like, no, I don't see it personally that way.
sentences.zh: 是个虚伪的人，或者是个伪君子之类的，不是真的，只是为了取悦他们而撒谎，但我当时想，不，我个人不这么看。

sentences.en: The important thing is that bit about the core.
sentences.zh: 重要的是关于核心的那部分。

sentences.en: The core of you is always the same about you.
sentences.zh: 你的核心永远是同一个你。

sentences.en: Because if I'm always the same and like, if I, you know, don't adapt to different environments, you know, I'm not going to, as you said, yeah, survive, but also thrive.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我总是保持不变，如果我不去适应不同的环境，正如你所说，我不仅无法生存，更无法茁壮成长。

sentences.en: I think that's the other important thing, you know, thrive in an environment where I feel happy and passionate about what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是另一个重点，在让我感到快乐和充满激情的环境中茁壮成长。

sentences.en: So that's kind of how I personally see it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我个人看待它的方式。

sentences.en: But yeah, every time I see that picture, I'm like, yes, it just forms my heart.
sentences.zh: 但每次看到那张画，我都会觉得，是的，它温暖了我的心。

sentences.en: I come from a slightly earlier era in life where we actually used to write each other letters and put stamps on them before emails dawned.
sentences.zh: 我来自一个稍微早一点的时代，在电子邮件出现之前，我们真的会给彼此写信并贴上邮票。

sentences.en: And one of my friends used to write like a little quote or a little like pause for thought nugget on the back of the envelope because he didn't want the postman to be bored.
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友会在信封背面写上一句小名言或一点思考感悟，因为他不想让邮递员感到无聊。

sentences.en: That is generally why, genuinely why he did it.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他这么做的原因。

sentences.en: And it reminded me of a little communication because postman must read postcards.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一个小插曲，因为邮递员肯定会看明信片。

sentences.en: And this isn't a postcard, it's a letter.
sentences.zh: 但这不是明信片，这是一封信。

sentences.en: And on the back of one of them, it said, if you've always done what you've always done, then you'll always get what you've always got.
sentences.zh: 其中一封信的背面写着：如果你总是做你一直做的事情，那么你就会一直得到你一直得到的结果。

sentences.en: And that is, you know, that's in essence what that is, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 本质上就是这个意思，不是吗？

sentences.en: I have loved our chat today.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢我们今天的谈话。

sentences.en: Like I'm so excited for just for you to become qualified, for you to stand there in your graduation robes.
sentences.zh: 我非常期待你获得资格的那一天，期待看到你穿着毕业袍站在那里。

sentences.en: And for me, in terms of change, I think I noticed it moSt.
sentences.zh: 至于改变，我想我感受最深的是在毕业典礼上。

sentences.en: I didn't go to my master's graduation because I think they forgot to tell me about it.
sentences.zh: 我没有参加硕士毕业典礼，因为我想他们忘了通知我了。

sentences.en: Oh gosh, that's not good.
sentences.zh: 天哪，那可不太好。

sentences.en: Yeah, they sent me a certificate in the post like six months later when I said, well, where is it?
sentences.zh: 是的，六个月后他们才把证书寄给我，当时我问他们，证书在哪里？

sentences.en: They didn't tell me.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没通知我。

sentences.en: So I only went to my undergrad and my doctorate graduations.
sentences.zh: 所以我只参加了本科和博士的毕业典礼。

sentences.en: So I only went to my undergraduate and my postgraduate doctoral graduations.
sentences.zh: 所以我只参加了本科和研究生博士的毕业典礼。

sentences.en: In my undergraduation, I felt a bit embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 在本科毕业典礼上，我感到有点尴尬。

sentences.en: I felt a bit silly, felt silly in my robes.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己有点傻，穿着毕业袍感觉很傻。

sentences.en: I felt a bit like a phony.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己像个冒牌货。

sentences.en: I didn't feel like a psychologist because I guess what I know is I wasn't one.
sentences.zh: 我没觉得自己是个心理学家，因为我知道我当时还不是。

sentences.en: And I was just a bit embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时有点尴尬。

sentences.en: I loved being with my family.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和家人在一起。

sentences.en: I loved being with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和朋友在一起。

sentences.en: I loved going out for dinner afterwards with our extended family.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢之后和大家庭一起出去吃饭。

sentences.en: But I didn't necessarily feel proud.
sentences.zh: 但我并不一定感到自豪。

sentences.en: Whereas my doctorate graduation, I honestly felt so very proud of everything I'd achieved,
sentences.zh: 而我的博士毕业典礼，我真心感到非常自豪，为我所取得的一切成就，

sentences.en: of wearing my little, you know, soft floppy cap, of being there with all of these incredible people who I called friends and colleagues.
sentences.zh: 为戴着那顶软软的方帽，为能和所有我称之为朋友和同事的了不起的人在一起。

sentences.en: And I was so pleased and proud for them as well.
sentences.zh: 我也为他们感到高兴和自豪。

sentences.en: I had this moment of standing.
sentences.zh: 我有过那样一个时刻。

sentences.en: I did Coventry and Warwick Uni and they take it in turns for the graduation.
sentences.zh: 我是在考文垂大学和华威大学读的，他们轮流举办毕业典礼。

sentences.en: One year we'll be in the Coventry Cathedral.
sentences.zh: 一年在考文垂大教堂。

sentences.en: One year we'll be in the Warwick in their theatre there.
sentences.zh: 一年在华威大学的剧院里。

sentences.en: And we had the Coventry graduation.
sentences.zh: 我们参加的是考文垂的毕业典礼。

sentences.en: And it was just like standing, queuing up by these, you know, amazing stained glass, waiting to go and get my handshake from the dean, whatever it was, with my parents watching.
sentences.zh: 当时就是排着队，站在那些令人惊叹的彩色玻璃窗旁，等着去和院长握手，无论那是什么仪式，我的父母都在看着。

sentences.en: And, you know, my, who is now my husband, was in a lecture theatre with his parents watching elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 而我现在的老公，当时正和他的父母在另一个演讲厅里看着。

sentences.en: And just, I just felt so incredibly proud.
sentences.zh: 我真的感到无比自豪。

sentences.en: And that is safe to feel about yourself, but also really lovely.
sentences.zh: 对自己有这种感觉是安全的，也是非常美好的。

sentences.en: And I, you know, I hope that you have that similar pride when it comes to be your time as well, Phil.
sentences.zh: 我希望当你到时候，也能有同样的自豪感，Phil。

sentences.en: Thank you, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Marianne。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So fingers crossed that, yeah, my graduation will be next year.
sentences.zh: 所以祈祷吧，希望我的毕业典礼能在明年举行。

sentences.en: I think they do it this summer after.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是在那个夏天之后举办的。

sentences.en: So there's quite a big kind of gap.
sentences.zh: 所以中间会有相当长的一段时间间隔。

sentences.en: But hopefully a proud Phil, proud Dr. Phil could be standing there.
sentences.zh: 但希望那时，一个自豪的Phil，一个自豪的Phil博士能站在那里。

sentences.en: And I think we should be proud at any point in time, even, you know, with the undergraduate.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在任何时候都应该感到自豪，即使是本科毕业。

sentences.en: That's massive.
sentences.zh: 那也是巨大的成就。

sentences.en: You know, that's a very big step in anyone's life.
sentences.zh: 那是每个人生命中非常重要的一步。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess that evidence is just how much I changed from the age of 21 to the age of, I think I was about 30.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想这证明了从21岁到30岁左右，我改变了多少。

sentences.en: You know, I'd grown a lot.
sentences.zh: 我成长了很多。

sentences.en: I've done a lot as well.
sentences.zh: 我也做了很多事情。

sentences.en: I've had a great time personally and professionally.
sentences.zh: 我在个人和职业生涯中都度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: There have been highs, there have been lows.
sentences.zh: 有高峰，也有低谷。

sentences.en: But genuinely, and I guess by the time I did my graduation for doctor, I'd already, I think that was November.
sentences.zh: 但真心说，我想在我参加博士毕业典礼时，那应该是十一月。

sentences.en: I was just about, I think, to start my qualified role because I actually had some time off unemployed because there was no jobs.
sentences.zh: 我当时正准备开始我的正式工作，因为我之前有一段时间失业，因为当时没有工作机会。

sentences.en: But yeah, I just, I just loved it.
sentences.zh: 但是的，我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我热爱它。

sentences.en: And yeah, in terms of growth, it, you know, there's nothing like it.
sentences.zh: 关于成长，没有什么能比得上它。

sentences.en: And then, of course, once you qualify, you continue to grow and you absolutely should.
sentences.zh: 当然，一旦你获得资格，你还会继续成长，而且你绝对应该继续成长。

sentences.en: So yeah, just yesterday, someone had said they'd been stopped from progressing to 8A because someone had said, well, you haven't done a specialist core thing.
sentences.zh: 就在昨天，有人说他们晋升8A级受阻，因为有人说，你还没有完成核心专业课程。

sentences.en: You haven't done a bolt-on therapy since qualifying.
sentences.zh: 你获得资格后还没有完成附加疗法培训。

sentences.en: And that wasn't something I'd ever heard of.
sentences.zh: 那是我从未听说过的事情。

sentences.en: But, you know, just in case people are listening, just try to get some sort of therapeutic skills advancement when you first qualify in the first couple of years.
sentences.zh: 但如果有人在听的话，刚获得资格的前几年，尽量去提升一些治疗技能。

sentences.en: But that said, you know, you can go straight to 8A from qualifying.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，你也可以从获得资格后直接晋升8A。

sentences.en: So that's not always necessary.
sentences.zh: 所以那并不总是必要的。

sentences.en: But part of the podcast, I like to kind of educate people as and when I hear things.
sentences.zh: 但作为播客的一部分，我喜欢在听到一些事情时教育大家。

sentences.en: So that might be something people might like to consider.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是大家可以考虑的事情。

sentences.en: So, Phil, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 那么，Phil，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You are going to be joining us for another episode because I've so enjoyed our chat that we've decided we're going to do what was our original plan as a second follow-up episode because it's just been so lovely to speak to you.
sentences.zh: 你还会参加我们的下一期节目，因为我非常享受我们的谈话，我们决定按照最初的计划进行第二次后续访谈，因为和你聊天真是太愉快了。

sentences.en: Have you got a last nugget of advice for helping people avoid burnout on their way as aspiring psychologists, Phil?
sentences.zh: Phil，你有什么最后的建议能帮助准心理学家们在前进的道路上避免职业倦怠吗？

sentences.en: Gosh, I could say so much about that.
sentences.zh: 天哪，关于这个我可以讲很多。

sentences.en: But I'll keep it simple.
sentences.zh: 但我会简单点说。

sentences.en: You know yourself beSt.
sentences.zh: 你最了解你自己。

sentences.en: So one thing at a time.
sentences.zh: 所以一次只做一件事。

sentences.en: That's something that has personally helped me a lot both before and during the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 这对我个人在博士学习之前和期间都有很大帮助。

sentences.en: Just chunking things.
sentences.zh: 就是把事情拆解开来。

sentences.en: Otherwise, you can easily get overwhelmed with how much stuff is happening altogether.
sentences.zh: 否则，面对同时发生的所有事情，你很容易感到不知所措。

sentences.en: Like, no, I'm going to do first this, then that, then that.
sentences.zh: 比如，不，我要先做这个，再做那个，然后做那个。

sentences.en: And obviously, life doesn't work that way, but I think even just saying it to myself helps a lot.
sentences.zh: 显然，生活并非如此运作，但我认为仅仅对自己说出来就很有帮助。

sentences.en: So give it your best shot.
sentences.zh: 所以尽你所能去尝试吧。

sentences.en: If it doesn't work, that's okay.
sentences.zh: 如果行不通，也没关系。

sentences.en: Just be kind to yourself.
sentences.zh: 对自己好一点。

sentences.en: That's so nice.
sentences.zh: 那太好了。

sentences.en: And, you know, just keep doing it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，坚持做下去就好。

sentences.en: If you think it's a bit of you, like it was for you, you know, what's another year between friends?
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这有点适合你，就像当初对你一样，你知道，朋友之间多一年又算什么呢？

sentences.en: You know, if this might end up being your fantastic, beautiful, joyful career.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果这最终可能成为你精彩、美好、快乐的职业生涯的话。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，Marianne。

sentences.en: I've loved it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这次交流。

sentences.en: I've loved it, Phil.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢，Phil。

sentences.en: Thank you for sharing your time so warmly with our audience as well.
sentences.zh: 也感谢你如此热情地与我们的听众分享你的时间。

sentences.en: And if people have enjoyed what we've said, then they can look out for our next episode, which will be coming probably in the next five or six weeks.
sentences.zh: 如果大家喜欢我们所谈论的内容，可以期待我们的下一期节目，大概会在未来五到六周内发布。

sentences.en: What an absolute pleasure it was to speak to Phil.
sentences.zh: 能与Phil交谈真是太愉快了。

sentences.en: I liked it so much that we are seeing him again for a future episode as well.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢，所以我们之后还会邀请他参加未来的节目。

sentences.en: So stay tuned for that in the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以请在接下来的几周里保持关注。

sentences.en: If you are intrigued to see what it is we're going to be talking about, I would love to know what you think to this episode.
sentences.zh: 如果你对我们将要讨论的内容感到好奇，我很想知道你对这一期的看法。

sentences.en: Come along and let me know in the Aspiring Psychologist community, which is my free Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家”社区（Aspiring Psychologist community）告诉我，这是我的免费Facebook群组。

sentences.en: If you like the way I do reflection,
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢我的反思方式，

sentences.en: if you like the way that it sounds like I can help you to grow and to shape your experiences and to get to where you want to be on the psychology career ladder,
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢我这种似乎能帮助你成长、塑造你的经历，并让你在心理学职业阶梯上达到目标的方式，

sentences.en: please do consider coming along and joining the Aspiring Psychologist community, which you can do from just £30 a month with no minimum commitment.
sentences.zh: 请考虑加入“有抱负的心理学家”社区，每月仅需30英镑，且没有最低承诺。

sentences.en: Please take a moment to rate and review and if you're watching on YouTube, please do subscribe, like, tell your friends, do all those good things.
sentences.zh: 请花点时间评分和评论，如果你是在YouTube上观看，请务必订阅、点赞、告诉你的朋友，做所有这些好事。

sentences.en: I hope you'll find some of the videos on screen coming up very shortly on YouTube to be useful for the next choice for you to watch.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得屏幕上即将出现的那些YouTube视频对你选择下一部观看的内容有所帮助。

sentences.en: I will look forward to coming along and seeing you for our next episode of the podcast, whether you listen or whether you watch from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我期待在下一期播客中与你相见，无论你是周一早上6点收听还是观看。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast, let's your side to be on your way.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客，让我们助你一臂之力。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 这是由Marianne Trent博士主持的“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家Marianne Trent博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得Sophie的奖励，以及我独家提供的支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组大师班、大师课程、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我都在这里。
